summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancing integration with Spark, particularly with the upcoming Spark 4.1 framework and improvements for small file workloads. Additionally, there are ongoing proposals to address metadata file size concerns and to implement fine-grained access control in the REST API.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Concerns about growing metadata.json file size and snapshot history
Proposal for fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable response
Java REST client URL encoding issues affecting compatibility
